name: RustRun
summary: RustRun is a side-scrolling mobile driving game in which the player drives a modified scrap car across a zombie-infested desert. The car has no health bar: its parts, such as the engine, wheels, armor and weapons, double as hit points and break off as it takes damage, so the car's appearance shows its remaining condition, and losing parts also makes it lighter and faster. Players run over zombies and smash obstacles to collect scrap, then use it in the garage to upgrade eight types of parts and rebuild the car's body, from a rusty wreck to a pickup truck. Escaping the desert in the story mode unlocks an endless mode with no upgrade cap. The game can be played offline and requires no account.
